From f851e03bce968ff9b3faad1b616062e1244fd38d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Alexey Simakov <bigalex934@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 13:20:17 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] ACPICA: Fix NULL pointer dereference in
 acpi_ev_address_space_dispatch()

Cover a missed execution path with a new check.

Fixes: 0acf24ad7e10 ("ACPICA: Add support for PCC Opregion special context data")
Link: https://github.com/acpica/acpica/commit/f421dd9dd897
Signed-off-by: Alexey Simakov <bigalex934@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Rafael J. Wysocki <rafael.j.wysocki@intel.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/3030574.e9J7NaK4W3@rafael.j.wysocki

diff --git a/drivers/acpi/acpica/evregion.c b/drivers/acpi/acpica/evregion.c
index fa3475da7ea9..b6198f73c81d 100644
--- a/drivers/acpi/acpica/evregion.c
+++ b/drivers/acpi/acpica/evregion.c
@@ -163,7 +163,9 @@ acpi_ev_address_space_dispatch(union acpi_operand_object *region_obj,
 			return_ACPI_STATUS(AE_NOT_EXIST);
 		}
 
-		if (region_obj->region.space_id == ACPI_ADR_SPACE_PLATFORM_COMM) {
+		if (field_obj
+		    && region_obj->region.space_id ==
+		    ACPI_ADR_SPACE_PLATFORM_COMM) {
 			struct acpi_pcc_info *ctx =
 			    handler_desc->address_space.context;
 
-- 
2.34.1

The patch fixes a NULL pointer dereference in the function `acpi_ev_address_space_dispatch()` inside `drivers/acpi/acpica/evregion.c`. The modification adds a check for `field_obj` being non-NULL before evaluating the condition `region_obj->region.space_id == ACPI_ADR_SPACE_PLATFORM_COMM`. Previously, the code could attempt to access `field_obj` (through the `ACPI_ADR_SPACE_PLATFORM_COMM` check) when `field_obj` is NULL, leading to a pointer dereference. The added condition ensures that only if `field_obj` is valid does the code proceed to handle PCC (Platform Communication Channel) specific context data. This covers a previously missed execution path where `field_obj` could be NULL.

**Changes per file:**
- `drivers/acpi/acpica/evregion.c`: In `acpi_ev_address_space_dispatch`, the single `if` condition checking for `ACPI_ADR_SPACE_PLATFORM_COMM` is extended with an additional predicate `field_obj &&` to guard against a NULL pointer dereference. No other files are modified.

Root cause:
The function `acpi_ev_address_space_dispatch()` in `evregion.c` does not check if `field_obj` is NULL before entering the code path that handles `ACPI_ADR_SPACE_PLATFORM_COMM` (PCC address space). This missing NULL check can lead to a NULL pointer dereference when the function is invoked with a NULL `field_obj`, a scenario that was not covered by the original fix for PCC support (commit 0acf24ad7e10).

Code statements information:
The code statements that lead to the bug are:
if (region_obj->region.space_id == ACPI_ADR_SPACE_PLATFORM_COMM) {
    struct acpi_pcc_info *ctx = handler_desc->address_space.context;
    ctx->internal_buffer = field_obj->field.internal_pcc_buffer;
Reason:
The original code does not check if `field_obj` is NULL before accessing its `field.internal_pcc_buffer` member. When `acpi_ev_address_space_dispatch()` is called with `field_obj` equal to NULL, the pointer dereference on `field_obj->field.internal_pcc_buffer` causes a NULL pointer dereference.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
if (field_obj
    && region_obj->region.space_id ==
    ACPI_ADR_SPACE_PLATFORM_COMM) {
    struct acpi_pcc_info *ctx = handler_desc->address_space.context;
    ctx->internal_buffer = field_obj->field.internal_pcc_buffer;
Reason:
The fix adds a NULL check for `field_obj` before the condition that accesses its fields. This ensures that the PCC-specific initialization code is only executed when `field_obj` is valid, preventing the NULL pointer dereference.

			ctx->internal_buffer =
			    field_obj->field.internal_pcc_buffer;
